units.known_address_notes: Halborn engagement is a penetration test of zkCross' cross-chain execution stack (EVM contracts, Soroban on Stellar, bridge/MPC services). zkcross.network/security documents the model: per-user vault contracts created per user, Guardian allow-list, MPC signing, bridge recipient pinned to the vault. docs.zkcross.network (llms.txt) has no contract-address page; no repo or address book found. Factory/implementation addresses unpublished, so the audited instance cannot be named -> PARTIAL.
